Key Responsibilities Data-Driven Pipeline & Funnel Management: Own daily, weekly, and monthly sales forecasts, analyzing conversion funnels, inquiry velocity, and individual KPIs to spot bottlenecks early and maximize acquisition ROI. Sales Floor Leadership & Coaching: Direct daily office-based sales operations, set clear accountability benchmarks, and provide targeted 1-on-1 coaching to increase close rates and average deal values. Playbook & Conversion Optimization: Leverage CRM reporting and customer interaction insights to refine discovery, objection handling, and closing scripts, running structured A/B tests across angles and segments. Cross-Functional Growth Alignment: Partner with internal teams using cohort and conversion data to improve campaign efficiency, shorten sales cycles, and strengthen post-sale retention. Team Scaling & Talent Development: Recruit, onboard, and mentor sales executives and team leads to support ongoing expansion. Candidate Profile Experience: Minimum 5 years of B2C or SME sales experience, including at least 3 years in sales management or team building (with proven multi-team leadership suited for the Senior level). Analytical & CRM Capabilities: Strong analytical mindset comfortable reading sales dashboards, tracking funnel conversion metrics, and turning raw CRM data into coaching and strategy, backed by advanced Excel/Google Sheets and modern CRM proficiency. Track Record & Leadership Style: Proven history of consistently exceeding team revenue targets in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment with a practical, roll-up-your-sleeves leadership style and sharp commercial acumen. Languages: Fluent in Cantonese and English; Mandarin is an advantage.
